user.title: Connect to Infuse
user.description: Enable Now Playing API in Infuse > Settings > Playback. For **posters**, you can optionally enter a **TMDB API Read Access Token** below. Playback metadata works locally without a token. You can also add the token later in Configure. [Get a TMDB token]({tmdb_api_url}).

data.name: Device name
data.tmdb_token: TMDB API Read Access Token for posters (optional)

confirm.title: Add {name}?
confirm.description: Use the discovered local Infuse Now Playing API for {name} at {host}:{port}. For **posters**, optionally enter a **TMDB API Read Access Token** if one has not been added for this device. Playback metadata works without it; you can add it later. [Get a TMDB token]({tmdb_api_url}).

init.title: Infuse settings
init.description: TMDB token saved: **{tmdb_status}** (✓ = saved, ✗ = not saved). The token field stays blank for security, even when one is stored. Leave it blank to **keep** the existing token. To change it, paste a new API Read Access Token; to delete it, select “Remove stored TMDB token”. Posters are optional. [Get a TMDB token]({tmdb_api_url}).
